source_text.ISS-0937:
id: ISS-0937
title: "Backend CI red at UTC month boundary: TenantTemplateTest parity (extra events_y2026m09) and PartitionMaintenance/RetentionOperations/EventRetention tests ({:error,:partition_not_eligible}) fail on 2026-10-01"
discovered_by: ELIXIR-DEV
discovered_in_run: WF03-ISS0930-20261001 (Step Final, PR #2076; filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-10-01T00:21:56Z"
severity: MAJOR
description: >
  PR #2076 (scripts/fixtures-only, no lib/ or migration change) had its backend job fail twice. Run 1: one TenantTemplateTest
  parity failure extra=["events_y2026m09"]. Re-run after the 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-01 UTC rollover: 12 failures in
  PartitionMaintenanceTest, RetentionOperationsTest, EventRetentionTest ({:error, :partition_not_eligible}). Hypothesis, not
  reproduced on main: the tests depend on the real current UTC month / partition eligibility and break at the month boundary.
  PR #2076 was merged with --admin per decision 0018. Confirm via main's CI on ed40c2fa, then make the tests clock-independent.
affected_files:
  - test/letflow/events/ (partition maintenance / retention tests)
  - test/letflow/tenants/ (tenant template parity test)
queue_ref: Q-920  # queue issue_ref ISS-0920 collides with an existing local file; local filename ISS-0937
github_ref: GH-2077
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 2 FIX DESIGN for ISS-0937 (month-boundary CI failures). Read the ISSUE-FIXER diagnosis in result.summary of step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json (root causes A: tests use 'last month' as always-eligible with min_partition_age_days=1, but eligibility requires today >= 1st of next month + N days, so fails on the 1st of each month; B: tenant template parity check_table_set/2 flags a stale dynamic events_yYYYYmMM partition as 'extra'). Verify the cited lines yourself in the worktree. Produce a design doc at lib/letflow/design/iss0937-month-boundary-test-clock.md (design only, no implementation code beyond signatures/pseudocode; the ONLY file you may write besides this handoff). Constraints: fix is tests/test-support only unless you find evidence in the code that contradicts the diagnosis (then say so); lib/ production code and migrations unchanged. Design must specify: (1) one shared pure helper (module, function name, @spec) that computes an always-eligible past month from an injected `today` and min age, used by all three retention test files, with exact offset rule and why; (2) the check_table_set/2 change so dynamic events_yYYYYmMM partition tables are ignored on BOTH sides (what precisely is filtered, regex/prefix, and that a non-partition extra table still raises); decide on the optional fingerprint change (recommend: do not, with reason); (3) fail-first regression tests that fail on pre-fix code independent of the real date: eligibility test iterating `today` over >=24 months incl. every 1st/2nd, and a parity unit test with two hand-built schemas; say exact file paths, test names, and what each asserts; (4) the comment corrections; (5) the audit for other tests/support using current_month() - 1 or similar clock-sensitive derivations (grep test/ for shift_months, current_month, Date.utc_today, DateTime.utc_now with partitions/retention) listing every site that needs change or confirming none; (6) final owned_modules. Check docs/anti-patterns.md and add a proposed anti-pattern entry text (do not write to that file; put proposed text in the design doc). Set status IN_PROGRESS at claim then COMPLETED/FAILED as normal. next_action 'Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR'.
acceptance_criteria: Every diagnosis cause has a concrete change
Fail-first tests specified independent of real date
No implementation code, no lib/ changes
